chose: Thumbnails stay on one axis: a deterministic, generic template that code fills from each episode's facts. The style may change in later versions (a pencil look, glass, a 3D pop), but only as code that draws the same bytes for the same inputs; the owner does no editorial work on a thumbnail, as on a video.
options: a deterministic generic template, its style iterated as code
a generator whose output can't be predicted, edited by the owner
gray: The owner, on the first template (C1026): the style can be iterated, but every iteration stays deterministic, because these toolkits share one aim, that the owner does no editorial tasks. Editing a derived title is left out for now.
undo: Only the owner can move this call.
